The workshop was a live demo providing an introduction to Quarto. Refer to the recording.

:::callout-note
## Topics covered include: 

* Using the assignment template (.zip, .Proj, .qmd)
* What is a Quarto file
* Difference between source versus visual editor
* How to render your .qmd file
* Setting up your `yaml` header
* How to write code and text together
* Setting up a code chunk 
* Setting code chunk options (globally and locally)
* Naming your code chunks
* Tips for debugging your Quarto file
* How to specify different rendering outputs 
* Markdown basics 

::: 

This demo should have provided a practical extension to the [startR module](https://startr.numbat.space/modules/writing/quarto-basics/) on Quarto basics. 

For more support refer to the [Quarto Website](https://quarto.org/docs/guide/).
You'll find there a link to [Quarto basics](https://quarto.org/docs/authoring/markdown-basics.html).
